question: In which year did India host second Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1982.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India organized the Asian Games for the second time in the year 1982.
 
• The games were held in New Delhi, the capital city of India.
 
• The mascot for the 1982 Asian Games was Appu, an elephant, symbolizing strength, speed, and a friendly nature.
 
• India finished fifth in the medal tally, securing
 
 
• 13 gold,
 
• 19 silver, and
 
• 25 bronze medals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Games**

 
 
• The Asian Games is the largest multi-sport event in Asia, organized every four years.
 
• The event is governed by the **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA)**, and the first edition took place in **1951** in New Delhi, India
 
• Over **45 nations** participate in the Games, competing in various disciplines such as athletics, swimming, badminton, and martial arts, among others.
 
• The Asian Games aim to foster unity, promote excellence in sports, and enhance cooperation among Asian countries through healthy competition.
